candidate_status: Awaiting Tom's review · used in the family release
author_review: Exact-export front, side, back and beauty stills compared with the concept FRONT/SIDE/BACK construction views and the three-quarter hero (concept-vs-export.png); five-clip normal/small motion sheets; attack front/side windup-contact-recovery; held defeat front/side/beauty inspected.
coordinator_review: Pending PLAN-019 coordinator intake. Not Tom approval.
concept_matching: Chunky yellow-lime stalk that splits into two bulbous feet with toe creases and, at the top, into thick branches separated by dark slits, as in the concept front and back views.
Broad dark-green crown about 0.75 m wide from about 0.52 m to 1.0 m, lumpy floret domes with painted curd bumps; low florets hang at the sides and back corners.
Big cream oval eyes with inward-glaring pupils and catchlights, thick dark brows tilted down to the middle, tiny pursed frown and warm cheeks.
Thin stalk arms from the stalk sides below the cheeks ending in broad cupped spinach-like leaf mittens at hip height.
Side view: crown centred behind the face with its front edge slightly ahead of it; the concept hero hands-on-hips pose is not the rest pose (the construction views are).
author_corrections: Checkpoint 1 (earlier run) was rebuilt: its stalk ended in a flat, jagged shelf with a thin pole under the top floret; the trunk is now about 15% narrower, flares gradually and splits into eleven fat branches whose tips end inside their florets.

Florets enlarged about 10%, bottom flattening reduced (0.74 to 0.86) and lobes strengthened so the crown reads as one lumpy cloud instead of mushroom caps; a bottom-centre back floret was replaced by two low back-corner florets to match the concept back view.
Curd texture changed from Voronoi cell edges (read as scales) to lit round bumps grouped in crevice-edged clusters.
Soft occlusion baked into COLOR_0 so slits, floret crevices, the leg notch and foot contact read dark in three.js.
Stalk palette shifted greener after sampling the render (#d0cb69) against the concept (#dbde74); leaves lightened slightly.
Feet rounded and widened into bulbous shoes; leaves broadened with rounded shoulders and turned 34 degrees from the front.
Crotch weights split smoothly between both legs after the first motion review showed a torn flap at the notch during the lunge and a V pinch in the held defeat.
Contact pose changed from a lean-back belly bump to a forward lunge with the leaves thrust out beside the face after the first motion review showed contact reading too close to the warning.

Defeat arms flopped outward after the source audit found a 2.6 cm leaf/stalk overlap; rest wrists moved 9 mm outward after the audit found 0.3 mm rest clearance. Final minimum leaf/stalk clearance is 4.9 mm.
limitations: Headless software Chromium is not physical Safari or hardware performance acceptance.
Attachment audit supplements the exact GLB all-vertex checks; it does not claim universal triangle collision testing.
The defeat is a planted squash-down sulk (hips drop 8.5 cm, feet splay); the leg-weighted lower stalk keeps the bottom above the floor rather than sitting flat.
Owner final-art review and runtime integration are separate from this authoring handoff.
